recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Do not change current source for FHIR-19517; any future review of isRecordOfRequest modifier semantics should be handled under the later MedicationRequest issues rather than by reverting this STU3 decision.
issue_request: FHIR-19517 asked Pharmacy to rename MedicationRequest.context to encounter as a 0..1 Encounter reference and to support reported MedicationRequest records by updating reported/informationSource semantics, including PractitionerRole as a possible information source.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to merge commit 7a787c5ab6b278c2af6d3644c38931486b7330f4 and implementation commit 417949e3bc69f9124d0e589d52b1b9acc47ca460, which changed context to encounter and changed the encounter search parameter, but also converted reported to reported[x] and removed informationSource.
additional_context: Later published/applied Pharmacy decisions refined the reporting model: FHIR-19640 restored informationSource and made reported a standalone boolean; FHIR-35847 changed informationSource to 0..*; FHIR-41408 added Group; FHIR-47855 clarified informationSource; and current source reflects the later FHIR-49863 rename from reported to isRecordOfRequest, with fhir.ini mapping the old reported[x] name to the current element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationRequest in active Pharmacy build scope, the current StructureDefinition has MedicationRequest.encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter), the search parameter is encounter, informationSource includes PractitionerRole and later Group support, and reported[x] is represented by isRecordOfRequest rather than the older name.
